digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API / external integration tests
propositions: rebar.llm.review_ticket() public API was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass but two external live-test modules still call it, causing AttributeError in 4 CI workflow lanes

The two missed call sites (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py:80 and test_llm_trace.py:151) were excluded from the standard Verified gate because they are marked external, so the removal was not caught until live workflow_dispatch
The retarget to review_plan fails because review_plan returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (no top-level findings) while both tests assert REVIEW_RESULT schema with runner/model/findings fields
Both external test modules were successfully retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code (the surviving public op returning REVIEW_RESULT with the required result contract)
Live workflow_dispatch validation shows external LLM and langfuse tracing lanes passing after retarget, with no review_ticket AttributeError occurrences
